description: This file defines API routes for managing claims within a FastAPI application, including creating claims, retrieving claim details and status, and listing claims with filtering options. It interacts with MongoDB collections for storing and retrieving claim data, sources, and analyses, and leverages background tasks for processing claims asynchronously.

methods.description: Serializes a source document from the database into a SourceItem schema object.

methods.name: ClaimItem _serialize_claim(doc: dict, sources: Optional[List[SourceItem]] = None, analysis: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Serializes a claim document into a ClaimItem schema, including sources and analysis data if provided.
